# @dsh-external/dsh-session-recap
English | 中文
## Summary
This bundle adds away recaps to a DeepSeek Harness session. When every Web client connected to the h
ost has explicitly been away for at least `idleMs`, the last completed turn is also older than `idle
Ms`, and the session reaches both `minTurns` and `minConversationChars`, the host asks an auxiliary
model for a short plain-text recap and stores it in a plugin sidecar. The Web client shows that reca
p above the composer when the user returns, with the current task, the important progress, and the n
ext action. `/recap` also generates one on demand, and `hostCommand: true` exposes the same command
to profiles that have no Web client.
## Install
Install from GitHub into a profile.

A git install runs the package `prepare` script and rebuilds `lib/`. pnpm 10 and newer refuse that b
uild until the profile allows it, so the first `add` can fail. Copy the exact package key pnpm print
s into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then run `add` again.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
That permission lets the package run code on your machine during install. Pin a commit (`github:DDDF
XYqiming/dsh-session-recap#<sha>`) if the repository may change. A tarball produced by `pnpm pack` i
nstalls without a build.
To install from a local checkout, build it first and point `add` at the directory.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Apply the update through the plugin manager, then reload the page. Restart the host if the manager r
equests it. Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` is required.
## Use this package
When you return to a session, a recap card above the composer shows the current task, the most impor
tant progress point, and the next action. The × button closes it. The card disappears when the sessi
on advances, and a session keeps one current recap.
Automatic recaps cover interactive sessions you have visited. Every WebUI page must explicitly remai
n away for at least `idleMs`; the last completed turn must also be at least `idleMs` old, the sessio
n must have at least `minTurns` completed turns, and real user/assistant text must contain at least
`minConversationChars` non-whitespace characters. Tool results and injected content do not count. Fo
cusing any WebUI page cancels scheduled and in-flight automatic recaps across all sessions. Switchin
g sessions within the focused application keeps it active. Starting a new turn cancels that session'
s generation and clears its previous recap.
Clients send a heartbeat every 20 seconds. An active client whose 45-second lease expires becomes un
known, and automatic recaps pause until that client reports an explicit state again.
To generate a recap at any time, run `/recap` from the slash menu. Profiles without a Web client set
`hostCommand: true` and receive the recap text from the host command instead of the card.
The recap follows the language of your own messages, not the language of pasted logs or quoted mater
recap follows the language of your own messages, not the language of pasted logs or quoted material.
## Configure
The bundle default row needs no configuration. To change a value, add an entry for `dsh-session-reca
p` to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Unset keys take the schema defaults below.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`provider` and `model` work as a pair. Leave both empty to reuse the provider and model from the ses
sion's last logged request. A recap route that uses a thinking model spends `maxOutputTokens` on thi
nking tokens too; if the first attempt produces no complete sentence, the plugin retries once with `
min(4096, max(2048, maxOutputTokens × 4))` tokens. `manualRequestTimeoutMs` bounds only the browser'
s wait for a manual request; generation continues on the host and a later poll updates the card.
A profile patch replaces the whole config for the row. Keys you omit take their schema defaults, so
a partial override is enough.
## Understand the implementation
Mechanics — click to expand
The host tracks turn boundaries through a session projection and owns app-wide client presence and c
ontinuous away time. Any active or unknown client pauses automatic generation. Automatic calls check
the same away period before starting and before publishing; manual calls remain independent of focu
s changes. See development notes for implementation details.
[该节后续省略]
#### What the model sees
One recap call sends a fixed system prompt and one user message. The system prompt asks for two to f
our plain sentences in the user's language, restates the `maxChars` hard limit, forbids Markdown and
label-colon outlines, and orders the content as current task, one important progress point or decis
ion, and one next action. The user message carries the JSON transcript frame `{ historySummary, goal
, recent }` and a `[recap-language]` directive built from up to three recent user messages. `history
Summary` is the newest compaction checkpoint, `goal` is the newest real user request when it fell ou
tside the window, and `recent` holds role-labelled conversation entries.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- **Automatic recaps need a Web client.** Away detection depends on client presence. A profile witho
ut a Web client gets `/recap` only when `hostCommand: true`, and never generates a recap on its own.
- **A model route must be available.** The host uses the explicit `provider` and `model` pair, or t
he route from the session's last logged request. With neither, generation fails and the host logs a

warning.
- **Thinking routes consume the output budget.** Reasoning tokens count against `maxOutputT
okens`. A small budget can return no complete sentence; the single escalated retry may still fail, a

nd `/recap` then reports the error.
- **Teammate and subagent sessions stay manual.** A session with
a parent session never arms an automatic recap, so a teammate conversation generates one only throu

gh `/recap`.
- **The route answers loopback clients only.** A remote or LAN caller cannot read a rec

ap from the host route, even with the right session id.
- **Dismissals are per browser tab.** The We
b client records a dismissal in `sessionStorage`, and another tab does not inherit it.
